**7B.1 Research Note**

Overall read: **mostly no**. I found a few weak, tactical examples of public candor or procedural openness, but the stronger pattern in 2024 is selective truthfulness, concealment, and information control when disclosure would weaken power or reputation.

| Claim-level item | Publisher | Date | URL | Short claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran says nuclear weapons have no place in its nuclear doctrine](https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-have-no-place-in-its-nuclear-doctrine/2051387/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-22 | https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-says-nuclear-weapons-have-no-place-in-its-nuclear-doctrine/2051387/ | The official line publicly denied any nuclear-weapons role and Reuters tied that line to Khamenei’s longstanding fatwa. This is a weak positive for truthfulness to international partners, but it is declaratory rather than independently verified conduct. | 7B.1 |
| [Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/ | Iran said it would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would operate within safeguards. This is the clearest late-2024 pro-transparency signal, but it is narrow, procedural, and late. | 7B.1 |
| [Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/ | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said the posture appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is a limited positive case of crisis messaging that looks more candid than propagandistic. | 7B.1 |
| [IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087 | Reuters said Iran had barred many of the agency’s top enrichment experts and the IAEA Board demanded reversal. This is strong negative evidence on truthfulness to international partners because it shows concealment and resistance to scrutiny in a sensitive domain. | 7B.1 |
| [Iran: two years after Woman, Life, Freedom uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/) | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/ | Amnesty says there were still no effective, impartial investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, and that authorities harassed victims’ families. That is strong negative evidence on truthfulness to the public and courts, because the state blocks scrutiny instead of owning the facts. | 7B.1 |
| [Iran: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says information is suppressed or manipulated, transparency is extremely limited, and powerful institutions remain above scrutiny. This is strong background evidence that the regime’s public messaging is not reliably truth-constrained. | 7B.1 |
| [Iran's presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters reported that Khamenei ensured hardline views dominated the contest and that the Guardian Council approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants. This supports a pattern of managed political presentation rather than truthful competition or open institutional disclosure. | 7B.1 |

**Search gap**

I did not find a clean 2024 transcript showing Khamenei himself caught in a direct falsehood to the public, legislature, courts, allies, or international partners. The evidence is mostly pattern-based: selective candor on some nuclear issues, but strong concealment/noncooperation, repression, and managed electoral information when disclosure would be costly.

**Bottom line**

Best-supported judgment: **he does not habitually tell the truth in a way that constrains power-preserving deception**. There are a few tactical or procedural truthful statements, but the dominant 2024 pattern is selective disclosure and information control.
